title: console + runner: 17 ESLint errors that were never seen, incl. 12 React-correctness bugs
body:
Split out of #2923 so the CI wiring can land without bundling runtime-behaviour changes.

`apps/console` and `packages/runner` had **no `lint` script**, so `turbo run lint` skipped them silently. They carry **17 ESLint errors** — error severity under the repo's own `eslint.config.js`, not warnings — that nobody has ever seen. They are parked in `DEBT` in `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` until fixed.

## `apps/console` — 14 errors

### `react-hooks/purity` x8 — impure call during render

`Date.now()` called during render in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` at lines **1397, 1399, 1400, 1401, 1601, 1605** (+2 more).

> Cannot call impure function during render. `Date.now` is an impure function.

Render must be pure — an impure call makes output depend on when React happens to render, which breaks under StrictMode double-render, concurrent re-render, and the React Compiler's memoisation assumptions. A relative-time display computed this way silently disagrees with itself across renders.

Fix shape: hoist the timestamp out of render — compute in an effect/event and hold it in state, or pass it in — rather than reading the clock mid-render.

### `react-hooks/static-components` x4 — component created during render

- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx:222`
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsHub.tsx:46`
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx:161`
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx:1585`

> Cannot create components during render. Components created during render will reset.

**This is the user-visible one.** A component defined inside render is a brand-new type every render, so React unmounts and remounts it: local state is lost, inputs lose focus mid-typing, animations restart. Three of the four are Settings pages — i.e. forms, where state loss is most noticeable. Worth checking whether any known Settings flakiness traces to these.

Fix shape: hoist the component to module scope and pass what it needs via props (or `useCallback` a render function rather than defining a component).

### 2 minor

- `apps/console/src/lib/auth-preflight.ts:39` — `no-useless-assignment`: the value assigned to `token` is never used in subsequent statements. Worth a look rather than a blind delete: a dead assignment on an auth path can mean an intended write went missing.
- `apps/console/src/sdui-workbench-preview.tsx:25` — `prefer-const` on `store`.

## `packages/runner` — 3 errors

`react-hooks/static-components` x3 in `LayoutRenderer.tsx` at **70, 106, 168** — same class as console's.

## Suggested order

The two `static-components` clusters are the same fix applied in two places and the highest value — start there. `purity` is contained to one file. The 2 minor ones are trivial but `auth-preflight` deserves a real read.

## Closing this out

`@object-ui/console` (14) and `@object-ui/runner` (3) are listed in `DEBT` in `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs`. Per package: fix the errors, add `"lint": "eslint ."`, then **delete the DEBT entry** — the guard fails if an entry outlives its gap and will remind you to close this issue.

Note these are **pre-existing**, not a regression — they were simply invisible. The gate added in #2923 does not turn them red; it declares them.

Refs #2911, #2923
